user.title: Tesla Fleet
user.description: Enter connection endpoints as hostname:port. OAuth credentials are configured through Application Credentials.

select_vin.title: Select Vehicle
select_vin.description: Choose which Tesla vehicle to use for this integration.

confirm_override.title: Overwrite Vehicle Config
confirm_override.description: The vehicle already has a fleet telemetry config for `${existing_hostname}`. Continuing will overwrite it with `${requested_hostname}`.

auth.title: Link Tesla Account
auth.description: Click the link below to authorize access to your Tesla account.

reauth_confirm.title: Relink Tesla Account
reauth_confirm.description: Your Tesla authorization needs to be refreshed. Continue to relink your Tesla account.

connection.title: Connection Settings
connection.description: Enter connection endpoints as hostname:port. The application domain is the domain registered on developer.tesla.com — required for partner account registration and virtual key pairing.

data_description.domain: Your app's root domain from developer.tesla.com allowed_origins. Used for partner account registration and the virtual key pairing URL.
data_description.mqtt_topic_base: The topic_base configured in your fleet-telemetry server's config (default: tesla).

error.invalid_mqtt_endpoint: Enter the MQTT broker as host:port.
error.mqtt_unreachable: Could not connect to the MQTT broker. Check the hostname, port, and firewall.
error.mqtt_timeout: Timed out connecting to the MQTT broker. Check that it is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.proxy_empty: Enter the Tesla HTTP proxy hostname or URL.
error.proxy_invalid_url: Enter a valid Tesla HTTP proxy hostname or HTTPS URL.
error.proxy_unreachable: Could not connect to the Tesla HTTP proxy. Check the hostname, port, and firewall.
error.proxy_timeout: Timed out connecting to the Tesla HTTP proxy. Check that it is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_hostname: Enter a public DNS hostname, not an IP address.
error.invalid_port: Enter a valid port between 1 and 65535.
error.invalid_ca: Could not parse the fetched telemetry server certificate.
error.ca_fetch_failed: Could not connect to the telemetry server to fetch the certificate. Check hostname, port, TLS certificate, and firewall.
error.ca_hostname_mismatch: Certificate fetched but hostname validation failed. The certificate must match the telemetry server hostname.
error.token_exchange_failed: Failed to exchange authorization code for tokens.
error.invalid_auth: The new token is not valid. Ensure you are using the correct Tesla account and that the OAuth app has the required scopes, then try again.

abort.missing_code: Authorization callback did not include a code.
abort.reauth_not_possible: Unable to start reauthentication for this entry.
abort.already_in_progress: Tesla authorization is already in progress. Finish the open authorization window or restart Home Assistant to clear the abandoned flow.
abort.vin_fetch_failed: Unable to fetch vehicles from Tesla Fleet API.
abort.no_vehicles: No vehicles were returned for this Tesla account.

init.description: Enter connection endpoints as hostname:port. Changing the application domain will trigger re-registration with Tesla.

confirm.title: Verify Virtual Key Pairing
confirm.description:
Pair the virtual key for **{vin}** using the Tesla app, then click **Submit** to verify.

Scan the QR code below or [open the pairing link]({pairing_url}):

[![QR Code]({qr_url})]({pairing_url})

entry_not_found.title: Integration Entry Not Found
entry_not_found.description: Could not find the Tesla Fleet Telemetry integration entry for this vehicle.

still_not_paired.title: Virtual Key Not Yet Paired
still_not_paired.description:
The virtual key for **{vin}** is still not paired. Open the Tesla app and pair the key, then click Fix again.

[Pair key]({pairing_url})

repair_failed.title: Repair Check Failed
repair_failed.description: Failed to check the virtual key pairing status. Ensure your telemetry server is reachable and try again.

init.title: Disable Unknown Field Entity
init.description:
The telemetry field `{field}` for vehicle **{vin}** is not recognized by Tesla. Click **Submit** to acknowledge and disable the related entity.

You can manually re-enable it in Settings → Devices & Services if needed.

application_credentials.description: Create Tesla OAuth credentials in the [Tesla developer console]({console_url}), then add them in Home Assistant Application Credentials.
